Palette gallery

palette-gallery.Rmd

This gallery is generated from the package’s offline registry, so it stays in sync with the colors returned by sc_palette(). Hover over a qualitative swatch to see its hexadecimal value.

Qualitative palettes are fixed sequences. scChromatic does not interpolate them by default; request extend = "generate" only when more colors are needed.

For signed values, pass the data midpoint to the scale so rescaling is centered correctly:

scale_color_sc_c("archr_coolwarm", midpoint = 0)
## <ScaleContinuous>
##  Range:  
##  Limits:    0 --    1

High-cardinality palettes are perceptually optimized or compatibility collections, not guarantees of universal color-vision-deficiency safety. Use sc_palette_audit() and combine color with labels, shapes, facets, or other encodings when distinctions matter.
